title: Chrono_Island
lead_summary:
Chrono Island, also known as Five Island is a small town that can be accessed from the North by the Water Labyrinth.
Team Rocket recently establish a Rocket Warehouse within the island's meadow. After defeating them, the harbour's sailor will offer the player to follow Team Plasma's motorboat to P2 Laboratory.

items.name: Max Potion
items.location_details: On the ground in the Meadow.
